measurements.name: selected_wavelength_um
measurements.method: Length unit anchored so the reference-run spectral peak equals the assigned cellular pitch
measurements.source: slot assignment 56 µm versus organ-tier sibling 2200 µm
measurements.note: value is the cellular pitch; reference_value is the 2.2 mm module pitch and must differ

measurements.name: geological_age_ma
measurements.method: White Sea Dickinsonia horizon used by Bobrovskiy et al. 2018
measurements.source: Bobrovskiy 2018; the 635 Ma reference is the end-Cryogenian, not this horizon
measurements.note: 558 != 635, so the age comparison is not self-referential

measurements.name: dispersion_pearson_r
measurements.method: Pearson r between measured spectral peaks and linear fastest wavenumbers across the diffusivity sweep
measurements.note: RMSE of the scaling law is reported separately

measurements.name: wavelength_scaling_rmse_um
measurements.method: RMSE of measured lambda(s) against 56*sqrt(s) after anchoring s=1 at 56 µm
measurements.source: a 10 µm tolerance, larger than the numerical residual

measurements.name: wavenumber_ks_statistic
measurements.method: Two-sample KS between shape-normalised measured and linear wavenumber sweeps
measurements.note: small KS means the sweep shapes agree; the reference is not the statistic

measurements.name: k_meas_over_k_linear_cv
measurements.method: Coefficient of variation of k_measured/k_linear across the sweep

measurements.name: ablation_std_ratio
measurements.method: std(u) of the Turing run divided by max(std(u)_control, 1e-4) on the same grid
measurements.source: null in which the control grows as much as the Turing run
measurements.note: equal-diffusion std falls to roundoff; the denominator is floored at 1e-4

measurements.name: specimen_ellipse_aspect_ratio
measurements.method: Gradient-energy ellipse on the CC BY 2.5 Dickinsonia costata photograph
measurements.source: circular null rejected by the ovoid outline in Evans et al. 2017
measurements.note: segmented on the real specimen image; value is not copied from the reference

measurements.name: specimen_structure_tensor_coherency
measurements.method: Mean structure-tensor coherency inside the specimen ellipse

measurements.name: specimen_ridge_spacing_over_body_length
measurements.method: Autocorrelation lag of a minor-axis transect, divided by the ellipse major axis
measurements.source: 56 µm divided by a nominal 10 cm body; the photographed ridges are the organ-scale modules
measurements.note: the specimen metric is the module repeat, not the 56 µm cellular pitch
